objective: Independent review of the TriageDesk delivery plan (plan gate, submission sub-muyntlor-01a9f206) against the approved spec and the design review's minor findings DES-8, DES-9 and DES-10.
context: The design was approved in rev-muynhokz-01357080 with minors DES-8 (Unicode-aware product-token mask), DES-9 (tune-mode exit-2 last line) and info DES-10 (task 11 must depend on task 6). Implementation will be done by real parallel subagents, so phases are small, ownership is per exact file, and each task's verification command runs only its own tests. Phase gates are sequential in ECCode, so parallelism is inside a phase, capped by config.maxConcurrency=2.
expectedOutput: A plan-gate review (approve or changes_requested) with evidence-backed criteria and findings.

The E5 freeze (three eccode evidence file records) is in phase foundation, before any rules file can exist

Wrote three plan check scripts used as verification commands (t01, t02 pre-freeze, t16) and exercised them on passing and failing synthetic fixtures in the scratchpad.
